_README: Single source of truth for the V5 budget. Every table in README.md is generated from this file plus inventory.json by scripts/build_tables.py. If you change a number here, re-run `make tables` and the README numbers move with it.

repetition_model._cite: Muennighoff et al. 2023, 'Scaling Data-Constrained Language Models'. Effective tokens D' = U * (1 + R_star * (1 - exp(-R / R_star))) where U = unique tokens, R = repetitions (epochs - 1).

lanes._floor_semantics: A floor is a hard minimum sampling probability that OPUS may not go below. It is enforced from `floor_active_from` onward. longctx has no floor before S3 because sequence length is 4096 until S3 - there is nothing to protect.

indic._synthesis_fraction_why: SOTA inventory: trusted non-synthetic Indic is ~114B raw / ~91B post-discount. Against a 288B slot that forces ~80% of the lane onto translated + already-catalogued Sangraha synthetic. Unverified crawl alone cannot cover a 30% tier anymore.

supply_model._why: Long context is a PACKING STRATEGY, not a token source. The SOTA inventory lists ~40B book-length corpora as native long text and ~60B repo-packed code as derived from the code lane. Borrowed tokens are DEBITED from the lending lane's supply so they are never counted twice.

anneal_reserve.policy: Tier A data is BANNED from stages 1-4 by a hard hash-based holdout on the sampler, not by a soft down-weight. A held-out shard cannot leak through OPUS.

components.why: NuminaMath + curated OpenMathReasoning holdout. Held back so AIME/MATH gains land when LR is low and the model retains them.
Answer-verified OpenThoughts2 / OpenR1 holdout. Unverified CoT goes in pretrain; verified CoT is the anneal payload.
SWE-Gym / SWE-smith / OpenHands rollouts whose final state passes a real test. Scarcest, most expensive tokens we own.
CommitPackFT diffs + high-quality Stack v2 repos shaped like SWE-bench edits.
20% of the whole anneal for 8% of pretrain. Deliberate over-weight from Sangraha verified. Indic is the capability most likely to be under-consolidated at the end of a 3.6T English-dominated run.
Repo-packed code and book-length packs at 128k. Long-context is a positional-extrapolation skill and consolidates best at low LR.
Small anti-forgetting ballast from FineWeb-Edu / DCLM so the anneal does not tank MMLU.

stages.name: S1 Foundation
stages.goal: Language, world model, syntax. Indic and agentic already sit at their floors - they are never introduced late.

stages.name: S2 Specialist
stages.goal: Code peaks at 40%. Sequence stays short for throughput.

stages.name: S3 Reasoning
stages.goal: Long CoT and reasoning-effort control tokens enter. Context 4k -> 16k.

stages.name: S4 Agentic + Long Context
stages.goal: Agentic peaks at 10.5% (2.6x its global share). Context 16k -> 64k. Terminal-Bench and RULER are won here.

stages.name: S5 Anneal (Tier A only)
stages.goal: LR -> ~0. Tier A reserve only. Indic and agentic deliberately over-weighted vs pretrain.

reasoning_bands._note: Applied as a control token <effort=...> on reasoning-bearing samples. Shares are of reasoning-tagged tokens, not of the whole budget.

synthesis_plan._note: Measured throughput comes from proxy/agentic_synth.py, which generates EXECUTION-GROUNDED traces (real commands, real stdout, real exit codes) rather than free-form LLM text.

agentic.generator: execution-grounded rollout: seed task -> plan -> real shell/tool execution in a container -> real observation -> verify against assertion

indic_translated.generator: IndicTrans2-class MT over STEM/code/web lane tokens, quality-gated by round-trip chrF++ and a native-speaker-audited sample

indic_synthetic.generator: multi-turn native-script dialogue + Romanised code-mixed conversation, seeded from verified-tier documents
